notes.title: New BIG update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078807/1083b59f2b53ba0de44b49e90a2cefce236539eb.jpg[/img]
It took a while, but the game is now better than ever.

Changelog:
[list]
[*] New achievement added
[*] Tosia and Bobbin's story updated
[*] Bunnies in the story tab now have their professions listed and a frame added
[*] The watch glows red when you run out of keys to wind up robots
[*] The watch now also shows how much time has been rewound
[*] A new Controls tab was added in the game
[*] Level and world markers in the menu now have a highlight
[*] Level name now has a frame
[*] Fixed a bug related to arrow key input handling in the first level
[*] When using the mouse to control movement, you can now cancel a direction choice and wait instead by positioning the cursor appropriately
[*] After collecting a story fabric, you can now click the background to close the screen
[*] Updated controller input for collecting story fabrics
[*] Mute button behavior in the settings has been changed
[*] In extra levels the hint button is now greyed out
[*] On level load the undo button is now greyed out during the first turn
[*] Updated the credits list
[*] Slightly tweaked level 1-12
[/list]

More fixes are coming soon. If you’d like to suggest any changes, feel free to post on the community tab or join us on Discord!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
We would like to thank all the people who played the demo and gave us feedback and those who visited our booth at PGA. Our backlog has grown a bit and we have a few more things to do before the full release. 
What we managed to do:
[list]
[*] we fixed the robot's blocking movement at some points in the game
[*] we optimized the number of elements on the map so that there will be a little more frames on larger levels
[*] we changed the position and visibility of the keys and the clock
[*] we improved Tessa animations
[*] we made a number of improvements to the settings
[*] we fixed copying of levels in the editor list
[/list]

We encourage you to play the demo create your own levels and give us more feedback to make the game even better.
